description: Per-account current balance (all-time) plus period_net (scoped to an already-resolved [period_start, period_end) window). Transfers excluded from both sums. Accounts with no transactions appear with 0/0.
name: account_balances

description: Average spending per day over a period. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: average_daily_spending

description: Apply a pending proposal this MCP client created, using the 6-character code the owner reads in monai. Never guess a code. Send the code as a string. Wrong codes count: 5 wrong codes lock the proposal for MCP, and an hourly limit stops MCP confirms. The owner can always approve in monai.
name: confirm_proposal

description: Search/filter accounts by name substring; returns ids, names, types, and currencies.
name: find_accounts

description: Search/filter investment platforms by name substring; returns ids, names, and kinds.
name: find_platforms

description: Search/filter individual transactions by merchant, category, period, and kind (all | expense | income); returns ids, dates, amounts, categories, merchants, and account ids. Rows are ordered most-recent-first. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: find_transactions

description: Total money received (income only, transfers excluded) over a period. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: income_total

description: Largest individual transactions by magnitude over a period. kind: expense | income. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: largest_transactions

description: The full category tree: top-level groups with nested children (id, name, kind, icon, effective color). Helps map a vague term to a real category or group name.
name: list_categories

description: Month-over-month income/expense/net for the last N months (months clamped to a minimum of 6; a rolling window, not a calendar-year bound). Transfers excluded.
name: monthly_trend

description: Net cash flow (income minus expenses, transfers excluded) over a period. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: net_total

description: Single trustworthy net worth = liquid accounts + investment platforms, each counted exactly once. Returns total, liquid_total, investment_total, liquid_accounts, investment_groups, accounts_covered, accounts_total.
name: net_worth

description: Propose transactions for the owner to approve; nothing is written until approved. Single row: rows=[{"date": "2026-01-15", "amount": -45000, "account": "Main Checking", "merchant": "Coffee Shop"}]. Up to 500 rows (for example every line read from a statement) go in one call as one batch. amount is signed (negative = expense, positive = income); account must be an existing liquid account (call find_accounts); category, if given, must be an existing category (call list_categories); dates are YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. Rows that look like an existing transaction or another pending row (same account and amount within 3 days) are returned in duplicates for the owner to review and are still proposed. To fix a pending proposal call again with replaces=<proposal_id>. Ask the owner for the 6-character code shown in monai, then call confirm_proposal. Never guess a code.

items.description: One proposed transaction row; no currency or is_transfer (D-04).

name: propose_transactions

description: Propose one transfer between two existing liquid accounts in the same currency (two ledger rows); nothing is written until approved. amount is a positive magnitude: the source is debited and the destination credited. date is YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. replaces=<proposal_id> fixes a pending one. Ask the owner for the 6-character code shown in monai, then call confirm_proposal. Never guess a code.
name: propose_transfer

description: Discard a pending proposal this MCP client created; needs no code. Proposals from other channels must be rejected in monai.
name: reject_proposal

description: Compare category spending before vs. after the earliest 'buy' event for a given ticker in portfolio_events, using equal-length before/after windows. Returns a structured error if no buy event exists for the ticker, or if the purchase date is today/future (no 'after' window yet).
name: spending_before_after_purchase

description: Top spending categories (expenses only) over a period, rolled up to top-level category groups — each group's total includes all its descendant subcategories; per-subcategory breakdown under 'children'. Transfers and system categories excluded. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: spending_by_category

description: Total spent in one category INCLUDING all of its descendant subcategories — a parent/group name sums its entire subtree (case-insensitive name match). period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: spending_in_category

description: Total money spent (expenses only, transfers excluded) over a period. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: spending_total

description: Count transactions over a period. kind: all | expense | income. period must be one of: this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year, last_30_days, last_90_days, all_time. Or pass period="custom" with ISO start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, end_date inclusive).
name: transaction_count
